Most health insurance claims in India get rejected, so why pay for a policy

According to IRDAI Annual Report 2024–25, 87% of health claims were paid and only 8% were rejected. As reported by IndiaMedToday, in 2023–24 about 83% were settled and 11% repudiated. Does that change how you see it?
premise: Most health insurance claims in India get rejected

text: Are you sure? I read most claims get rejected.

IRDAI Annual Report 2024–25 shows that 87% of health claims were paid and only 8% were rejected. As reported by IndiaMedToday, in 2023–24 about 83% were settled and 11% repudiated. Does that affect your view?
My friend said 70% of claims are rejected.

IRDAI Annual Report 2024–25 reports that 87% of health claims were paid and only 8% were rejected, which is far lower than 70%. As reported by IndiaMedToday, in 2023–24 about 83% were settled and 11% repudiated. Does that make you reconsider the 70% figure?
